string.name: login_sso_hint
string.value: Next, the Tsinghua SSO page opens in a web view. Please complete sign-in there (including the verification code).

string.name: login_network_hint
string.value: Requires the campus network or the university VPN.

string.name: login_failed
string.value: Sign-in failed. Please try again later.

string.name: sso_state_lost
string.value: The sign-in state was lost. Please go back and sign in again.

string.name: sso_resource_missing
string.value: An app resource is missing, so the sign-in page cannot be opened.

string.name: err_network_unreachable
string.value: Cannot reach Learn. Please make sure you are on the campus network or the university VPN.

string.name: err_auth_failed
string.value: Incorrect student ID or password, or the session has expired.

string.name: err_api_changed
string.value: The Learn service appears to have changed, so sign-in is temporarily unavailable.

string.name: err_logout_incomplete
string.value: Sign-out is incomplete: local credentials could not be cleared. Please try again.

string.name: err_trust_limit
string.value: The trusted-browser quota for Tsinghua SSO is full. Go to id.tsinghua.edu.cn → Account Settings → Multi-factor Authentication → Trusted Browsers → Maintain, delete the devices you no longer use, then sign in again.
